baseline.method: Reproduced PlasmaPy native OML/two-stage Maxwellian/Druyvesteyn, standard-method reference, not actual truth

metric_definitions.eedf_relative_l2: L2 norm of distribution error divided by reference L2 norm
metric_definitions.energy_max_abs: Maximum energy-axis absolute error in eV
metric_definitions.parameter_max_relative: Maximum of absolute relative errors over all eight signed scalar quantities; no alignment or rescaling
metric_definitions.normalization_error: Absolute departure of absolute trapezoidal distribution integral on the descending energy axis from one

reference_role: Standard-method output. Agreement does not establish accuracy of the plasma model or physical parameters.
tolerance_provenance: Frozen before extraction. Exact original reruns and local numerical comparison are documented in test/validation.md. Nonzero tolerances permit numerical roundoff without admitting a zero or changed-scale distribution.
